entities.name: César Vargas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: César Vargas is a Mexican professional baseball pitcher for the Pericos de Puebla of the Mexican League. He has previously played in the Major League Baseball (MLB) for the San Diego Padres and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Orix Buffaloes.
